   The user reported that the app silently falls back to default config without any warning when their `.bivvy.yml` is invalid, and asked for this to be fixed. The core intent is to surface warnings when config fields are unrecognized/misspelled rather than silently ignoring them and using defaults.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Rust project "bivvy" - CLI for development environment setup automation using declarative YAML config
   - Serde deserialization with `#[serde(default)]` and `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]`
   - `#[serde(flatten)]` is incompatible with `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]` - this is the root cause
